canonical_name: UniHive Research Proposal Competition (also referred to as the FRI -- Future Researcher Initiative -- Competition)
provider_type_note: DECISION-CRITICAL FINDING, directly on point for this brief's explicit warning against describing a competition as university-administered without official-structure evidence: UniHive Education's OWN disclaimer states 'UniHive Education contracts with the Colleges and centres of the University of Cambridge for the use of facilities' but 'has no formal connection with the University of Cambridge,' and further clarifies its programmes 'do not form any part of the recruitment or admission process of these higher education institutions.' UniHive Education is a private company that RENTS Cambridge venue space; it is not Cambridge-affiliated, endorsed, or administered. This is the same disclosure pattern this lane already found and recorded for the live Blackstone Law Review row (no Cambridge affiliation despite the name) -- a second, independently-confirmed instance of the same red flag shape in this corpus.
